gloss: city council member; city assembly member

definitions.gloss: city council member; city assembly member
definitions.explanation: Short for {市議会|しぎかい}{議員|ぎいん}, a member of a city's elected assembly. The short form is standard in news headlines and reports.

examples.japanese: {市議|しぎ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当選|とうせん}→当選：07074_tousen⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was elected to the city council.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{市議|しぎ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}する→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧。
examples.english: To consult the local city council member.

examples.japanese: {市議|しぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{三期|さんき}⟦{務|つと}めた→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧あと、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{市長|しちょう}→市長：12472_shichou⟧⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立候補|りっこうほ}→立候補：13778_rikkouho⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: After serving three terms on the city council, he ran for mayor.

notes:
FORMS:
The parallel short forms are {県議|けんぎ} (prefectural assembly member), {都議|とぎ} (Tokyo Metropolitan Assembly member), {区議|くぎ} (ward assembly member) and {町議|ちょうぎ} (town assembly member). The election is a {市議|しぎ}{選|せん} (⟦{市議会|しぎかい}→市議会：23608_shigikai⟧⟦{議員|ぎいん}→議員：02660_giin⟧⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {市議|しぎ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当選|とうせん}→当選：07074_tousen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be elected to the city council
- {市議|しぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧: to serve as a city council member
- ⟦{元|もと}→元：03878_moto⟧{市議|しぎ}: former city council member

WATCH OUT:
The homophone しぎ also names the snipe ({鴫|しぎ}), a bird.
